name: Galileo-ft
summary: Deep-space fintech style with near-black navy surfaces, ultrathin 100-weight display typography, cobalt primary actions, lavender hairline borders, large rounded cards, and restrained teal-to-cobalt brand gradients.

typography.primary_fallback: Inter Light, Neue Haas Grotesk Display Thin, Untitled Sans Light, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.display_fallback: Inter Thin, Neue Haas Grotesk Display Thin, system-ui, sans-serif
traits: negative tracking on large display type

layout.composition: full-bleed deep-navy hero with split text and 3D glass visual, followed by rounded product cards and two-column sections

do: Use Plain Ultrathin weight 100 for all large headings.
Use 48px radius for buttons and nav pills.
Use 35px radius for cards and panels.
Use Pulse Cobalt only for primary filled actions and active states.
Separate dark surfaces with 1px violet hairlines.
Use teal-to-cobalt gradients only on full-bleed banners.
dont: Do not use 600 or 700 headline weights.
Do not add drop shadows to cards or buttons.
Do not use more than one vivid accent color per surface.
Do not use solid underlines for links.
Do not set body copy below weight 300.
Do not use sharp corners on interactive elements.
Do not introduce extra dark canvas colors.
